overrides.reason: DSBAND is an ARPACK driver from EXAMPLES/BAND, outside the vendored SRC/UTIL directories, so there are no source facts. Its package is arpack, and LDA is the shared leading dimension of AB, MB and RFAC (the doc says so; the signature cache cannot tie it to an array).

IWORK is declared IWORK( * ), so the spec has no extent from the source, but the doc gives "Integer array of dimension at least N" (dsband.f:250) and dsband passes it to DGBTRF as the N-element IPIV (dsband.f:463, 480, 506). Without a minimum, strided.js had no length check and a short IWORK dropped pivots silently (ticket 0107).
